sentences.text: IBAC reported to Parliament on its first five years of exposing and preventing public sector corruption and police misconduct.
sentences.support: report to Parliament on our actions to date, and reflect on future opportunities to strengthen Victoria’s corruption resistance

sentences.text: The report covers investigations, police oversight, prevention work and opportunities to strengthen its powers and independence.
sentences.support: Independent oversight of police to ensure they perform their duties and exercise their powers with integrity

sentences.text: IBAC reported completing 55 investigations and making 93 recommendations to police and public sector agencies.
sentences.support: Recommendations to police and public sector agencies 93

sentences.text: The Commissioner sought powers to follow public money through private providers, initiate proceeds-of-crime recovery and receive funding directly through Parliament.
sentences.support: IBAC be funded through appropriations directly from the Parliament

findings.quote: After just five years, it is reasonable to conclude that IBAC has changed perceptions about corruption in Victoria.

notes: The Commissioner’s reflections provide an equivalent overview. The report is an institutional retrospective; its 93 recommendations are a cumulative activity measure, not a new recommendations list.
